text:
Sapporo started what its organisers call Japan's first illumination in 1981 with about 1,000 bulbs. This December the lights and a German Christmas market fill Odori Park together, until 25 December 👇

🤔 Guess what's new in Sapporo's lights this year, then check 👉 https://japanbystation.com/sapporo-in-december-2026

We took our time with this one and checked every date and hour against Sapporo's official pages.

🎄 THE CHRISTMAS MARKET

The Munich Christmas Market is in its 25th year, a sister-city tradition. Glühwein, sausages, pretzels and German crafts, 11:00–21:00 daily, last order 20:45. Every stall takes cards.

✨ THE LIGHTS

Odori Park is lit until 25 December. The streets stay lit much longer: Ekimae-dori until 11 February, Minami 1-jo's ginkgo tunnel until 14 March.

🆕 NEW IN 2026

The red-brick former Government Office glows blue after dark. And from 9 to 28 January, Nakajima Park gets giant light creatures you can walk inside.

❄️ OUR TAKE

Come before the 25th to get both. Stay in Odori so the market is two minutes from bed, and use the underground walkway when the snow is heavy.
